nphi.title: QUANTUM – quality and utility labels for health data (EHDS)

nphi.with: Instituto Aragonés de Ciencias de la Salud (coordinator); 35 partner organisations
nphi.summary: Project developing quality and utility labels for health data for the European Health Data Space, with 35 organisations across 14 countries including Norway.

nphi.title: HSE support to Ukraine: emergency resuscitation training and equipment
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: University College Dublin (Ukraine Trauma Project); NGOs
nphi.summary: The HSE Global Health Programme funds an emergency resuscitation training project with University College Dublin and sends medical equipment to Ukraine through NGOs.

nphi.title: HSE–Zambia partnership on specialist training and medical equipment (EQUALS)
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: Zambian College of Medicine and Surgery; Royal College of Physicians of Ireland (EQUALS Initiative)
nphi.summary: Ireland's HSE helped set up Zambia's postgraduate specialist training (college founded 2017), ships reusable equipment and trains biomedical engineers; the RCPI-backed EQUALS model was later extended to Uganda.

nphi.title: HSE–Mozambique quality and safety partnership
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.summary: Under an agreement signed in 2014, the HSE has supported quality-improvement training in 15 Mozambican hospitals since 2016.

nphi.title: HSE–Ethiopia partnership on quality improvement and staff resilience
nphi.actor: Health Service Executive (HSE) Global Health Programme
nphi.with: Ethiopian Ministry of Health; Ethiopian Public Health Institute (EPHI)
nphi.summary: Ireland's HSE worked with Ethiopia's Ministry of Health and EPHI on quality-improvement training (completed 2020), staff mental-health and resilience workshops, and planned support for hospital accreditation.

nphi.title: LINDA-FAMILIA – scaling up digital health systems
nphi.summary: EDCTP3 project in which NIPH leads implementation science and trials of digital registries for maternal and child health in four African countries.
